title: iPhone 18 Pro 256GB Black $1949 Delivered @ Skytree Phones
body:
Deal: iPhone 18 Pro 256GB Black $1949 Delivered @ Skytree Phones

[hawkeye93] Looks like Skytree owner is a member of Ozbargain too :))
[nickelanddime] If you're reading this, please put a good iPhone 17(e) deal out! I beg
[Lynx33] I think you mean wouldn’t budge over the colour ?
[nickelanddime] Skytree is banned for price matching but employees in store may not care
[cruisinforaboozin] Nah they wouldn't honour the price match online with any colour, customer rep kept saying in-store has more discretion than over phone, in-store the bloke was like "sure" and got manager to authorise the price beat with the 5% - did go late on a Monday night, may have helped.
[coldazure] They have the Glacier at $1960 under a different listing entirely. Not sure why they did it like this but if this is your preferred colour then here you go: https://skytree.com.au/products/iphone-18-pro?_pos=2&_sid=6f…
[zealmax] Officeworks $1946 after price beating Costco. Costco are selling 18 Pro for $2049. Officeworks is price beating Costco again.
[azzaisawesome] Officeworks don’t price match Skytree!!!
[cruisinforaboozin] Persist, I called three stores before one agreed to do it!
[tryingtohelp] Just today, I tried to price beat black 18 pro 256 at Epping office works and was turned down only because the note at the bottom of the Costco page said “Products purchased today will not ship immediately due to high demand. Products is expected to ship between 4th to 11th November 2026. Dates may vary”
WTF!!!!
[Dumpshid] That is true. No one will price match out of stock products.
[dcypher] I went in-store to OW to get the price beat. The person that I got to talk to first tried to deny by warranty differences, model number etc. Once they "agreed" they said they had no stock, when the OW website clearly said they had one lol. I should have asked first if it was available.
[mickmac] The Ron burgundy is actually showing 1925 for me. Almost enough to pull the trigger with sky tree tbh.
